segments.ja412:1.3: Tañca mañca mahākāyaṃ, dhārayaṃ nappavedhasi [na pavedhayi (ka.)].
segments.ja412:2.3: Dhārayaṃ byathasi [byādhase (sī.), byadhase (pī.), byādhasi (ka.)] bhītā [bhīto (sī. syā. pī.)], kamatthaṃ koṭasimbali [koṭisimbali (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja412:3.1: Maṃsabhakkho tuvaṃ rāja, phalabhakkho ayaṃ dijo;
segments.ja412:3.5: Assatthāni ca bhakkhitvā, khandhe me ohadissati.
segments.ja412:4.1: Te rukkhā saṃvirūhanti, mama passe nivātajā;
segments.ja412:4.3: Te maṃ pariyonandhissanti, arukkhaṃ maṃ karissare.
segments.ja412:5.1: Santi aññepi rukkhā se, mūlino khandhino dumā;
